secops_skills.name: file_streamer
secops_skills.description: Handles large file payloads by allowing chunked, segmented appending to bypass LLM max_token generation constraints. Essential for writing files that exceed single-turn output limits.

start_file.description: Create (or overwrite) the target file and open a stream session.

filepath.description: Destination file path (relative or absolute). Parent directories are created automatically.

overwrite.description: If false (default), returns an error when the file already exists. Set true to truncate and replace.

append_chunk.description: Append a text chunk to a previously opened stream. Call repeatedly until all content is written.

filepath.description: Must match the filepath used in the corresponding start_file call.

content.description: Raw text content to append. No size restriction — split across as many turns as needed.

finalize_file.description: Close the stream session. Must be called once after all append_chunk calls.

filepath.description: Must match the filepath used in start_file.
